condition: With make_subplots, setting hoversubplots="axis" doesn't show hover labels across subplots, because each subplot gets its own x axis (xaxis, xaxis2, …), even when shared_xaxes=True.
workaround: Don't use make_subplots. Use layout grid with go traces that all set xaxis="x" and give each trace its own y axis (y, y2, y3), as in the Plotly docs' "hover on subplots" example.
